Name: Animated Mining Pack
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Animated Mining Pack

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Adds animation for nodes, gems, ores, bars, geodes & other mining related objects.[/size]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/s5RmFRL.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=2]1.1.0 Added minerals and meteorite.
[/size]1.2.0 Added animations to the stuff from the 1.5 update.

[b][size=5][u]Installation[/u][/size][/b]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]
[/url][/size][size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/YC9IjYX.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/5AJViXE.gif[/img][/center]
[b][u][size=5]Config[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i][size=3]config.json[/size][/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.[/size]
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i][size=3]content.json[/size][/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.[/size]

[size=3]Some items have different versions, for example: "PrismaticShard", "PrismaticShard2" and ""PrismaticShard3D". [u][b]You [/b][/u][/size][size=4][b][u]can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/u]. 

[u][size=5]Extra[/size][/u]
[/b][/size][size=3]I highly recommend checking out undare's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4986]Animated Gemstones[/url] mod, you can use both mods as long as you only have one animation enabled for each item in the config file.
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/rNeSLxT.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/WhNKSAF.gif[/img][/center][/size]
